title: VPC operator state drift triggers failed Helm upgrades; hotpatch + rollback runbook
creator: Ava Patel
description: Multiple Private/VPC customers reported upgrade failures during operator/Helm rollouts over the 2026-03-09 -> 2026-03-10 window. Failures surface as Helm hooks timing out and the operator repeatedly reconciling a deprecated CRD state. Investigation shows drift between operator-managed ConfigMaps and cluster-side manual edits (annotations and resourceVersion mismatches) causing the operator's controller to reject upgrades and fail to complete post-upgrade reconciliation. This ticket consolidates the hotpatch, rollback runbook, and follow-up hardening work. Affected: 3 enterprise customers on private clusters (two in EMEA region, one in APAC), all using our VPC installer and opting out of automatic config sync. Primary customer symptom: repeated operator crashloops and failed Helm releases leaving workloads in a partial state (some pods updated, others not).
steps_to_reproduce: On a VPC/on-prem test cluster, install operator version 2.3.7 via Helm with custom annotations on redwood-config ConfigMap
Manually edit the operator-managed ConfigMap to add a non-whitelisted annotation and change resourceVersion (simulate drift)
Attempt to helm upgrade to operator 2.4.0; observe Helm hook jobs time out and 'helm upgrade --install' exits non-zero
Check operator logs: repeated reconciliation loops and errors indicating validation failures for the mutated ConfigMap
kubectl get events shows 'operator rejected update - immutable field modified' on CRDs/ConfigMaps
mitigation_taken: Opened priority support channel and engaged on-call SRE and operator owners immediately
For the three impacted clusters, applied temporary patch that forces operator to accept legacy annotation key (hotpatch) and restarted operator pods to break crashloop
Coordinated with customer admins to revert manual ConfigMap edits where possible and run 'helm rollback' to previous stable chart in two customers where hotpatch couldn't be applied
Published a temporary runbook to on-call and support: sequence for safe rollback, when to scale operator replicas to 1, and checks for pending finalizers
Created emergency branch private-operator-2.4.1-hotfix with the annotation-acceptance patch and smoke tests; prepared PR for fast-track review
action_items: Ship hotfix release private-operator-2.4.1 with backward-compatible annotation handling (owner: Diego Morales, due 2026-03-12)
Publish an official rollback runbook for customer support and solutions engineering (owner: Lin Zhao, due 2026-03-13)
Add validation to Helm chart install/upgrade to detect config-drift and fail fast with actionable error messages (owner: Sofia Green, estimate 5)
Implement operator readiness gating to prevent partial upgrades when reconciliation backlog > threshold (owner: Diego Morales, estimate 8)
Add an integration test that injects controlled ConfigMap drift and asserts operator can reconcile or fails with clear remediation steps (owner: QA Team, estimate 3)
Schedule customer outreach calls to the three affected customers with postmortem and roadmap for safeguards (owner: Customer Success, due 2026-03-18)
Follow-up: evaluate auto-detect config drift feature and opt-in sync for Private customers (product review requested)
Add telemetry to Console to flag clusters with persistent reconciliation errors (observability ticket)
